app.name: Sahakar Sahayak
app.notice: Information about cooperative law, not legal advice.

shell.noHistory: Conversations you start will be listed here.

landing.title: Cooperative law, answered with the section it comes from.
landing.subtitle: Ask about membership, elections, audits and bylaws in your own language. Every answer cites the Act, so you can check it yourself.

cites.title: Cites the section
cites.body: Each answer points to the section it relies on and flags any it could not verify against the indexed text.

languages.title: Four languages
languages.body: English, Hindi, Marathi and Tamil. Type the question or speak it.

jurisdictions.title: Six jurisdictions
jurisdictions.body: The Multi-State Act and the state Acts of Maharashtra, Gujarat, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and West Bengal.

procedures.title: Step-by-step procedures
procedures.body: Registration, elections, general meetings and disputes, with the forms, fees and deadlines each one needs.

steps.title: Ask in your own words
steps.body: Type or speak the question in English, Hindi, Marathi or Tamil. No legal phrasing needed.

steps.title: It reads the Act
steps.body: The assistant searches the Act and rules for your jurisdiction and checks each section it finds against the indexed text.

steps.title: You get the sections
steps.body: The answer cites every section it relies on, marks anything it could not verify, and flags matters that need the Registrar or a lawyer.

procedures.title: Procedures, step by step
procedures.body: Each guide lists the forms, fees, deadlines and the authority to approach.

glossary.title: One vocabulary, four languages
glossary.body: Legal terms keep the same meaning whichever language you ask in.

trust.title: What it is, and what it isn't
does: Cite the section of the Act behind every answer
Tell you when a section could not be verified
Point you to the Registrar or a lawyer when a dispute or deadline is involved
doesNot: Give legal advice or represent you
Guess when the Act is silent — it says so

items.q: Which Act does it answer from?
items.a: The one you pick. The Multi-State Act is the default; switch to a state Act from the picker at the top of the app.
Yes. Tap the microphone in the composer and speak. Voice input works in Chrome and Edge.
Conversations stay in your browser so you can reopen them. Questions the assistant was unsure about go to a review queue to improve future answers.
No. It explains cooperative law and cites its sources. For a dispute or a deadline, confirm with the Registrar's office or a lawyer before acting.

cta.title: See it answer a real question
cta.body: Sign in with the demo account and ask about your society.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the demo account to explore the assistant.
login.error: That email and password don't match.

chat.placeholder: Ask about membership, elections, audits, bylaws…
chat.voiceUnsupported: Voice input needs Chrome or Edge
chat.emptyTitle: What do you need to know?
chat.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line

examples.question: How many members do we need to register a new society?
What is the quorum for an annual general meeting?
Can the board extend its own term?
How do I file a complaint against the managing committee?

chat.unverified: Could not verify — check the Act
chat.escalate: This involves a dispute or a deadline. Confirm with the Registrar's office or a lawyer before acting.
chat.lowConfidence: The Act is not clear on this. Treat the answer as a starting point.
chat.error: The answer could not be generated. Check that the service is running and try again.

checklists.title: Procedures
checklists.subtitle: Step-by-step guides with the forms, fees and deadlines each one needs.

admin.title: Admin
admin.documentsIntro: Every Act, rule and circular the assistant can cite. Re-index after uploading a new version.
admin.glossaryIntro: Legal terms and their translations. The assistant uses these to keep wording consistent across languages.
